in_hindi.name: फजरुल
in_hindi.meaning: फजर या सुबह की रोशनी या दिन की शुरुआत
in_hindi.long_meaning: नाम फजरुल फजर से लिया गया है, जो सुबह की रोशनी या दिन की शुरुआत को दर्शाता है। यह नाम प्रकाश और मार्गदर्शन और नए शुरुआत का प्रतीक है। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, फजरुल का नाम अक्सर सुबह के समय जन्मे लोगों के लिए चुना जाता है या जिनकी जिंदगी में एक नई शुरुआत हुई है। यह नाम इस्लामी परंपरा में आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है, जो फजर की नमाज और दिन की शुरुआत के समय को महत्व देता है।

in_english.name: Fajrul
in_english.meaning: Dawn or morning light or new beginning
in_english.long_meaning: The name Fajrul is derived from 'Fajr', which refers to the dawn or morning light. In Arabic, 'Fajr' means 'to break out' or 'to shine', symbolizing the emergence of sunlight. This name holds significant spiritual meaning in Islamic tradition, as dawn is considered a sacred time for prayer and reflection. Fajrul represents illumination, guidance, and a fresh start. Historically, the term 'Fajr' is mentioned in the Quran, specifically in Surah Al-Fajr, emphasizing its importance in Islam. The name Fajrul is popular across various Muslim cultures, signifying hope, renewal, and the pursuit of knowledge.

data.cultural_impact: In Islamic culture, the Fajr prayer is the first prayer of the day and is traditionally performed just before sunrise. The name Fajrul may be given to a boy as a reminder of the importance of starting the day with this early morning prayer and with positive intentions.
data.spiritual_significance: In the Islamic tradition, dawn represents renewal and a fresh start to the day. The phrase "Fajrul Idris", which means "Shape of Idris at Dawn", is used to describe Prophet Idris (Idris) as a man of strong faith and good character. Bestowing the name Fajrul upon a child can serve as a source of inspiration to strive for spiritual growth and morally sound intentions throughout one's life.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Fajr ul-Layl signifies the "Dawn of the Night." It is a name given to a blessed night in Islamic tradition, believed to be especially conducive for spiritual growth and communion with the divine. This name evokes a sense of anticipation and hope, symbolizing the potential for renewal and transformation that lies within each of us.
